channel.title: Wildcard Watch: WSO2
channel.description: Exploited vulnerabilities and attacks involving WSO2, each with its fix status and first step.

item.title: Keep patched: WSO2 (multiple products): Path Traversal
item.description:
WSO2 (multiple products): Path traversal (file read/write) · pre-auth · internet-facing · exploited · fix: 4.5.0.57, 4.6.0.21, 4.5.0.56

First step: Update the affected WSO2 products to the fixed version for your release line (for example 4.5.0.57, 4.6.0.21 or 4.5.0.56).

WSO2 API Control Plane, API Manager, Traffic Manager & Universal Gateway contain a path traversal vulnerability that could allow for unrestricted file upload and lead to remote code execution.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-5430
